text: We recommend that you invest the £14,500 you have available as a lump‑sum into a Stocks & Shares ISA (wrapper “ss_isa”) holding the Aldercroft Balanced Growth Fund.

This recommendation is made before any transaction is carried out and will be set out in writing for you to review and confirm [FF:C001:recommendation_context.recommended_wrapper][FF:C001:recommendation_context.investable_amount_gbp][FF:C001:recommendation_context.contribution_type]
- **Primary objective:** build a fund for a career break [FF:C001:objectives.primary_objective]
- **Target amount:** £142,000 [FF:C001:objectives.target_amount_gbp]
- **Investment horizon:** you have indicated “around 5 years” in the fact‑find [FF:C001:objectives.horizon_text] (you also mentioned “about 10 years” during the meeting) [TR:C001:0004]
- **Attitude to risk:** moderately adventurous (ATR score 4) [FF:C001:objectives.atr_score][FF:C001:objectives.atr_descriptor]
- **Capacity for loss:** high, based on substantial liquid assets and high disposable income [FF:C001:financial_situation.capacity_for_loss][FF:C001:financial_situation.capacity_for_loss_basis]
- **Financial situation:**
- Gross annual income £211,000 (salary) [FF:C001:financial_situation.gross_annual_income_gbp][FF:C001:financial_situation.income_source]
- Essential monthly outgoings £2,500; discretionary £1,450 [FF:C001:financial_situation.monthly_essential_expenditure_gbp][FF:C001:financial_situation.monthly_discretionary_expenditure_gbp]

- Cash savings £15,000; no other investments or liabilities [FF:C001:financial_situation.assets.cash_gbp][FF:C001:financial_situation.assets.investments_gbp][FF:C001:financial_situation.liabilities_gbp]
- Emergency fund covering 6 months [FF:C001:financial_situation.emergency_fund_months]
- **Knowledge & experience:** previously held cash savings, funds and shares; you trade only rarely [FF:C001:knowledge_experience.products_held_before][FF:C001:knowledge_experience.trading_frequency]
- The ISA wrapper provides tax‑free growth, matching your “additional” tax band and the desire to maximise the fund for a career break [FF:C001:client.tax_band][FS:ISA:05]
- The Aldercroft Balanced Growth Fund aims for capital growth over a 5‑plus‑year period, aligning with your stated horizon of around 5 years [FS:ISA:02]
- The fund’s risk indicator is 4 of 7, consistent with your moderately adventurous risk attitude [FS:ISA:03][FF:C001:objectives.atr_score]
- Total annual charges of 0.85 % are transparent and low‑cost, supporting good value for a high‑income client [FS:ISA:04]
- Your high capacity for loss and substantial disposable income mean you can tolerate the market and currency risks inherent in the fund [FS:ISA:03][FF:C001:financial_situation.capacity_for_loss]
- **Market risk:** the value of the fund can fall below the amount invested, especially in a bad market year [FS:ISA:03]
- **Currency risk:** non‑GBP holdings expose you to exchange‑rate movements [FS:ISA:03]
- **No capital guarantee:** you may not get back the full £14,500 [FS:ISA:03]
- **Minimum holding period:** the product is designed for a minimum of 5 years, so early withdrawal may affect performance [FS:ISA:03]
- **Liquidity:** withdrawals are processed within 5 business days and, as a non‑flexible ISA, withdrawn amounts cannot be replaced in the same tax year without using your ISA allowance [FS:ISA:06]

ADVISER FLAG: Conflict between client’s stated investment horizon of “around 5 years” in the fact‑find and “about 10 years” expressed in the meeting transcript [FF:C001:objectives.horizon_text][TR:C001:0004]
- Platform fee 0.25 % p.a.
- Fund ongoing charge (OCF) 0.60 % p.a.
- No entry, exit or performance fees [FS:ISA:04]
- Illustrative total annual cost 0.85 % p.a. [FS:ISA:04]

Given the 5‑year investment horizon and the market risk profile, a periodic review (at least annually) is likely to be needed to ensure the investment remains on track to meet your career‑break fund target [KB:COBS_9A_3:02_what_the_report_must_contain_do_paraphra]

This suitability report is provided to you before any transaction is concluded, in a durable medium, and sets out the advice we are giving, why it is suitable, the risks, costs and the likely need for periodic review [KB:COBS_9A_3:02_what_the_report_must_contain_do_paraphra]
